about_the_game:
Welcome to the frontline of "Ants with Guns," where the insect world meets modern warfare! Experience the scientifically accurate battle simulator that brings ants to the forefront of the battlefield, armed with newfound firepower.

So now you can make ants battle for queen and candy in this new breed of sandbox battle simulator.

Place ants in our sandbox mode demo and watch 'em fight, or take control and get in on the action.

Dive into the world of "Ants with Guns" – where war is small in scale but big on excitement! Command your ant troops, witness epic battles, and explore a battlefield like no other. After all, ants have been warriors longer than we've been players.

No ants were harmed in the creation of this game.∗

∗Maybe... we honestly weren't really paying that close of attention.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7200U CPU
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 940MX
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Unleash chaos in "Ants with Guns," a sandbox battle simulator where ants wage war with firearms, face other bugs, and fight for queen and candy supremacy. Command your ant army, engage in epic battles, and conquer the battlefield—tiny scale, huge stakes!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Spanish - Latin America*
*languages with full audio support
